text: For the leader; According to Jeduthun. A psalm of Asaph.
I I cry aloud to God,I cry to God to hear me.
On the day of my distress I seek the Lord;by night my hands are stretched out unceasingly; [AA]I refuse to be consoled.
When I think of God, I groan;as I meditate, my spirit grows faint. [AB]Selah
You have kept me from closing my eyes in sleep;I am troubled and cannot speak.
I consider the days of old;the years long past
I remember. [AC]At night I ponder in my heart;and as I meditate, my spirit probes:
"Will the Lord reject us forever, [AD]never again show favor?
Has God's mercy ceased forever?The promise to go unfulfilled for future ages?
Has God forgotten how to show mercy,in anger withheld his compassion?"Selah
[1] I conclude: "My sorrow is this,the right hand of the Most High has abandoned us." [AE]
II [2]I will recall the deeds of the Lord;yes, recall your wonders of old. [AF]
I will ponder all your works;on your exploits I will meditate.
Your way, God, is holy;what god is as great as our God? [AG]
You are the God who does wonders;among the peoples you have revealed your might. [AH]
With your mighty arm you redeemed your people,the children of Jacob and Joseph. [AI]Selah
The waters saw you, God;the waters saw you and lashed about,even the deeps of the sea [3] trembled. [AJ]
The clouds poured down their rains;the thunderheads rumbled;your arrows flashed back and forth. [AK]
The thunder of your chariot wheels resounded;your lightning lit up the world;the earth trembled and quaked. [AL]
Through the sea was your way;your path, through the mighty waters,though your footsteps were unseen. [AM]
You led your people like a flockby the hand of Moses and Aaron. [AN]
